gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported a prior period reserve release of GBP 15.2 million in 2017, primarily driven by favourable claims development in its aviation, energy, and property lines of business. This release represents a 1.58% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. The year 2017 also saw significant catastrophe losses, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, earthquakes in Mexico, and US wildfires, which collectively resulted in net catastrophe-related losses of GBP 61.3 million for the syndicate.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2017 with gross claims reserves of GBP 962.146m. Prior-year development produced a net favourable movement (a release) of approximately GBP 31.7m (around 3.30% of opening gross claims reserves), driven by favourable claims development across several lines. The managing agent reports net prior period reserve releases of GBP 15.2m (net) and attributes releases primarily to favourable experience in aviation, energy and property; however, the gross prior-year movement has been calculated from the published gross claims development triangle and therefore the gross release is larger. Current-year catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes and US wildfires) produced significant 2017 catastrophe losses, but these relate to the current year rather than prior-year run-off.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle because the explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note only discloses net (after reinsurance) figures. As a result: (1) the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m (-31.728) is derived from the gross triangle (calculation confidence 0.8); (2) per-LOB prior-year movements used the net per-LOB breakdown presented in the movement note and were mapped to standard LOB names approximately (confidence 0.5); (3) named catastrophic events are listed as mentioned in narrative but per-event net impacts on reserves were not quantified in the report; mapping of 'Marine, aviation and transport' to 'Marine' and 'Third party liability' to 'Casualty' is approximate for the lob_movements entries.
